description: Source code for firmware image encoding and decoding, including header structures, checksum calculations, and file processing functions.

classes.name: img_header
classes.description: Structure representing the firmware image header with metadata such as size, checksum, and identifiers.

classes.name: firmware_type
classes.description: Structure defining firmware type identifiers and their string names.

classes.name: capwap_header
classes.description: Structure for CAPWAP protocol header containing module, SKU, firmware version, date, and model size.

methods.name: get_file_size
methods.description: Returns the size of a given file.

methods.name: header_checksum
methods.description: Calculates a simple checksum by summing all bytes in the header.

methods.name: md5_file
methods.description: Calculates the MD5 hash of a file.

methods.name: encode_image
methods.description: Encodes a firmware image with optional CAPWAP header, applying encryption and padding.

methods.name: decode_image
methods.description: Decodes an encrypted firmware image, restoring original content.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the command-line utility.
